def find_initial_arrangement(n, x, final_boxes):
    initial_boxes = [0] * n
    current_box = x - 1
    total_balls = sum(final_boxes)
    
    for _ in range(total_balls):
        initial_boxes[current_box] += 1
        current_box = (current_box + 1) % n
    
    return initial_boxes
